subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw require signed macOS desktop assets and a beta Sparkle appcast for this beta train, or explicitly leave this beta package-only under the current release-channel policy?
rationale: The source tree and public release state show the gap, but only maintainers with release policy and private signing authority can decide whether to retroactively publish old beta desktop assets or treat future beta gating as the real fix.

options.title: Decide through the signed-beta PR
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 or a narrower successor, then use the private release workflows only after the source-side beta desktop contract is approved.

options.title: Declare this beta package-only
options.body: Document that v2026.5.22-beta.1 will not receive macOS desktop assets and close this tracker while keeping any future beta policy work separate.

options.title: Keep manual tracker only
options.body: Leave the issue open as a release-owner reminder without queueing automated source work until the beta desktop policy is clarified.

recommendation.title: Decide through the signed-beta PR
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88845 or a narrower successor, then use the private release workflows only after the source-side beta desktop contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release-control and beta-verifier work makes this the closest current source-side owner for deciding the release gate shape.
